MIT-licensed Rust crowdfunding template source and a walletless browser simulation. The documented rules pay the creator after a reached goal or return each contribution after a missed goal. There is no milestone release or partial-funding payout. The current README explicitly says the template has not been published to Esmeralda or mainnet. The linked creator video is retained through the original submission. This recording shows the public README; no template or simulation was executed.

MIT-licensed merchant payment-link and invoice prototype with a browser simulation and Rust template design. The hosted page labels payments as simulation and identifies its merchant and transactions as fictional seed data. Payments are recorded locally; real wallet signing and mainnet settlement are future work in the README. The recording walks through documentation and its labeled interface diagrams, not a working payment transaction.

MIT-licensed bug-bounty escrow template source with a walletless browser simulation. Researchers submit report commitments and sponsors decide validity; accepted findings draw from a proposed locked pool. The model cannot force honest sponsor triage or detect reworded duplicate reports. The browser uses a temporary demo encryption key, not a production key-management system, and sends no real funds. The recording shows the README and documented template methods. No deployed network contract is established by these sources.

MIT-licensed rotating savings-circle template, CLI and walletless browser simulation. Every member contributes each round and receives one pot; a one-round deposit can cover a missed contribution. The creator documents template 3519aefd3d17e2bb88f061e1490a8107925381cf7c4af3f5911c4c1668e01b11 and the Uselu circle on Esmeralda. A November 17 read of the linked official testnet indexer returned the circle substate. The hosted browser page is explicitly a simulation. This is testnet evidence, not Ootle mainnet deployment. The recording shows the README and network-specific documentation.

MIT-licensed fee-reconciliation tool by HarbourRelay. The current hosted description offers a mainnet browser tool for up to 20 public transaction IDs and a PowerShell 7 CLI supporting mainnet and Esmeralda. Missing or conflicting replies leave the amount blank for review. Both indexers are operated by Tari, so their agreement is an operational comparison, not independent settlement proof. The browser sends entered transaction IDs and normal connection metadata to those public indexers. This recording shows the creator announcement. The source archive and JavaScript attachment were not downloaded or executed.

deploymentEvidence.detail: Current released hosted tool description offers mainnet browser fee comparisons and a PowerShell 7 CLI supporting mainnet and Esmeralda. This is a read-only utility, not a deployed smart-contract claim.

entries.evidence: MIT-licensed rotating savings-circle template source and walletless browser simulation. The creator describes fixed contributions and a full pot paid in member order after everyone contributes; late recipients wait until they pay. The hosted Indonesian-language page identifies itself as a simulation, and the README says it is disconnected from wallets and networks. No current Ootle deployment is established by these sources. The recording shows the README, including simulation scope. Creator test claims are attributed source statements; no template was executed here.

MIT-licensed bug-bounty escrow template source and walletless browser simulation. The proposed flow records report hashes, lets sponsors approve or reopen a bounty, and lets a fixed trusted referee resolve disputes; timeout refunds the sponsor. The referee still judges report validity. The current README explicitly says the template is unpublished on Esmeralda and mainnet, and its Live tab is a placeholder. November 17, 2026: server-side extraction of the linked demo returned empty content; the creator-provided simulation destination is retained, with the README as the source walkthrough. No wallet or template was executed.

BSD-3-Clause Rust reconciliation tool with a hosted read-only review page. It compares payment outcomes, assets, integer amounts and payees, keeping receipt provenance in CSV output. Its samples distinguish local-engine grant payments from archived Ootle mainnet auction proceeds and escrow funding; those archives do not establish a deployed grant contract. The README explicitly excludes wallet signing and on-chain deployment. November 17, 2026: server-side extraction returned the hosted review interface and its offline/read-only boundary. The recording is a walkthrough of the Chinese-language README, not an application run or independent verification of the archived receipts.

MIT-licensed collectible-crafting game source and walletless simulation. The proposed Rust template burns EMBER and a forge fee to mint tiered relics, combines three matching relics into a higher tier, and melts duplicates into materials. The admin-badge holder controls fee withdrawals. The README and hosted page explicitly say the template is unpublished on Esmeralda and mainnet. Simulation amounts and NFTs have no real value; creator engine-test claims remain attributed source statements. The source warns that its randomness is game-grade. This recording shows the README and deployment limits; no game or template was executed.

MIT-licensed rotating savings-circle source with a walletless simulation and a documented Esmeralda deployment. Fixed members contribute each round; unpaid contributions become arrears, and a recipient in arrears misses that round's payout. The creator documents template f230b6fbe6409c10c8f3d9dbf47a722a0b7ab956d32ed5b57a1fd35e9e8399a5 and circle component_fe42c4e6f21f2066cac7acdabb5fabcd9bd365af8aadd154ece22dd0d2f601e8. November 17, 2026: the official Esmeralda indexer returned that circle as an up substate at version 3. The hosted page opens in simulation mode and its extracted live-mode instructions still contain older Phase 3 setup text; use the dated creator proof for deployment scope. No mainnet deployment is claimed. This README walkthrough does not demonstrate wallet interaction or independently replay the creator's payout tests.
